label: D2 after choosing a2, strongest on a2->S1 rare transitions, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and 90% of its mass comes when the agent chose a2. The largest activations are on a2 -> S1 rare transitions (top quartile about 100% covered by a2&S1). Magnitude is highest when the previous trial was rewarded (r1 a2 S1R gives about 0.9-1.0 of max) and lower after r0. Weaker activations (about 0.1-0.2) show up on a2 -> S2 common D2 steps and, less often, on a1 -> S1 common ones (about 0.4). The unit depends strongly on episode time: it fires a lot in trials 0-30, fades by about trial 60 and never fires after trial 70. That suggests a slowly drifting hidden state, not a task variable. It never fires at D1 or GO. The predicate uses only variables observed at D2 (action, state) plus episode time, and no future variables. Dev F1 is 0.74 with mass recall 0.90. Requiring S1 alone or a2 alone loses precision. The time cutoff is approximate, and some weak early-episode activations on a1 remain unexplained.
